sam: new mock for Playback Scrubber + Safety Net for rollouts. figma: https://figma.redwood/playback-scrub — scrub to preview traffic over time, safety net blocks immediate full rollouts without extra confirm. thoughts? mei: like the idea. scrub preview should be lightweight (no diffs) and show only aggregate traffic + error rate sparkline. jules: agree. microcopy: preview header -> 'Preview traffic at this point in time' not 'Snapshot' (less ambiguous). priya: safety net UX q: do we block the final 'Promote to 100%' button until a cooldown or require explicit 'Confirm promote' typing? prefer explicit confirm for prod. sam: leaning explicit confirm for prod. for staging we can allow quick promotes. maybe a toggle 'Safe mode: ON' per environment. accessibility-bot: accessibility notes: ensure scrubber is keyboard operable, announce preview values via aria-live, and provide an accessible label for the slider thumb. mei: handoff snippet for aria: ```html

Playback scrubber

Previewing traffic: Variant A 60% — Error rate 0.4%
``` jules: good. copy nit: button label 'Promote to 100%' vs 'Make live' -> prefer 'Promote to 100% (requires confirmation)'. keeps clarity. priya: also add audit trail link nearby: 'View audit log' small link. and explain cooldown tooltip for promoted actions. sam: accessibility + copy + tokens to update. can we finalize these by tomorrow AM? devs want to start wiring scrubber interaction. mei: i'll update the figma frame with aria notes and the 'Safe mode' toggle variants. jules: i'll update copy strings and add the 'Promote to 100% (requires confirmation)' CTA. accessibility-bot: created task #6001 "playback-scrubber-safetynet-a11y". reminders set. sam: awesome, thanks team :sparkles:
